subject.title: docs: add Crabbox Windows validation skill

question: Should this repository permanently own the full Windows-specific Crabbox skill, or rely on the canonical shared Crabbox skill with a smaller repository-specific validation overlay?
rationale: Both approaches are technically viable, but selecting the durable ownership boundary and accepting its synchronization cost requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Own the local skill
options.body: Merge the repository-local workflow after recording canonical provenance, an update policy, and current-head native-Windows proof.

options.title: Use a thin overlay
options.body: Keep the shared Crabbox skill canonical and place only Windows-node commands and repository-specific proof requirements in the existing local validation guidance.

recommendation.title: Own the local skill
recommendation.body: Merge the repository-local workflow after recording canonical provenance, an update policy, and current-head native-Windows proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history most strongly connects this person to Windows build, CI, and validation-policy decisions.
